Urgent land acquisition proposals accepted at any time, outside the grant cycles

range.quote: Competitive proposals are generally up to $3 million per project. However, GOCO may consider more significant investments in high-impact projects when funding is available.

caps.what: grant share of a conservation easement's value (not fee simple acquisitions)
caps.quote: Up to 50% of the value of a conservation easement (this does not apply to fee simple acquisitions)

match.quote: GOCO does not have a set match requirement for our funding opportunities

award.quote: Generally, up to $3 million per project. GOCO may suggest a revised award amount as needed.

sections.name: Brief project description
sections.quote: Brief project description (50 words or less; 3-4 sentences)

sections.name: Concept Narrative
sections.quote: Write a short narrative (up to 2 pages; 11 pt font or larger; 1-inch margins) in response to the following prompts.

sections.name: Proposal Narrative
sections.quote: Responses to Proposal Narrative prompts (up to five pages)

criteria.name: Resource conservation
criteria.quote: Resource conservation – We value strategic land conservation and resource protection work.

criteria.name: Outdoor stewardship
criteria.quote: Outdoor stewardship – We support sustainability of and improvements to the state’s natural and recreational resources.

criteria.name: Community vitality
criteria.quote: Community vitality – We invest in conservation and outdoor recreation efforts that support communities and quality of life.

criteria.name: Equitable access
criteria.quote: Equitable access – We partner with communities to break down barriers to the outdoors.

criteria.name: Youth connections
criteria.quote: Youth connections – We believe children and their families deserve opportunities to get outside and experience all the benefits of doing so.

criteria.name: Urgency (threat of conversion or time-sensitive issues)
criteria.quote: Urgency – Priority goes to projects with significant natural resources and community benefits under threat of conversion, or projects that address time-sensitive issues.

criteria.name: Need (benefit most from GOCO funding, leverage, statewide distribution)
criteria.quote: Priority goes to projects that will benefit most from GOCO funding, whether there are few other funding options or GOCO’s contribution will help leverage a match from another organization or the community.

criteria.name: Outcomes (public access, habitat, watersheds, viewsheds, cultural resources, parks for disproportionately impacted communities)
criteria.quote: Outcomes –We consider how projects provide or protect passive public recreation access; essential wildlife habitat and migration corridors; critical watersheds, waterways, and riparian ecosystems

criteria.name: Advancing relevant plans and resources
criteria.quote: Advancing relevant plans and resources – We consider how projects align with local, regional, or statewide efforts

format.quote: Text documents should use 11 pt font or larger and have 1-inch margins. Please submit materials in plain text (no letterhead or logos).

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: Colorado cities, towns and counties; Title 32 special districts eligible for Conservation Trust Fund distributions; land conservation organizations; political subdivisions whose mission is open space; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
eligibility.quote: Organizations eligible for GOCO funding include Colorado cities, towns, and counties; Title 32 special districts; land conservation organizations that advance the acquisition of open space; political subdivisions of the State of Colorado whose missions are to identify, manage, or acquire open space and natural areas; and Colorado Parks and Wildlife.

eligibility.item: Eligible projects are fee-simple land acquisitions that provide public access; conservation easements are considered when tax credits are financially insufficient or impractical
eligibility.quote: Eligible projects are fee-simple land acquisitions that provide public access. GOCO also considers conservation easements when tax credits are financially insufficient or impractical.

eligibility.item: The full application is by invitation only, after GOCO reviews concept papers
eligibility.quote: The full application is by invitation only, after GOCO reviews concept papers

eligibility.item: Acquisition costs for existing buildings and other structures, and project contingency, are not covered
eligibility.quote: The following expenses will not be covered: • Acquisition costs associated with existing buildings and other structures • Project contingency

eligibility.item: Projects involving federal land must be discussed with GOCO staff before submitting a concept paper or application
eligibility.quote: Applicants seeking funding for projects involving federal land must discuss the proposal with GOCO staff prior to submitting a concept paper or application.

eligibility.item: GOCO cannot participate in acquisitions involving condemnation or the threat of condemnation
eligibility.quote: GOCO cannot participate in property acquisitions involving condemnation or the threat of condemnation.

eligibility.item: Fee title applicants must discuss their plan to protect the property from development with their GOCO regional program officer
eligibility.quote: Applicants seeking funding for a fee title acquisition must discuss their plan to protect the property from present and future development with their GOCO regional program officer.

requiredDocuments.item: Concept paper: budget on the GOCO template (xls or xlsx)
requiredDocuments.quote: Budget – available on Land Acquisition Web page; submit file in xls or xlsx

requiredDocuments.item: Transaction and Due Diligence information (required attachment; also in the final application)
requiredDocuments.quote: Required Attachments • Transaction and Due Diligence information
Maps (up to two pages) - We recommend a context map showing surrounding land uses and a detailed/schematic map.

requiredDocuments.item: Project photos or footage (up to two pages)
requiredDocuments.quote: Up to two pages of photos, links to property footage, or other assets that display the property.

requiredDocuments.item: Final application: resolution from the applicant's governing body meeting GOCO's resolution requirements
requiredDocuments.quote: Resolution from the applicant’s governing body (your resolution must meet GOCO’s resolution requirements )

requiredDocuments.item: Final application: wildlife review and completed Wildlife Review Form (with the local CPW Area Wildlife Manager)
requiredDocuments.quote: Projects invited to the application phase will be required to submit the wildlife review form.

requiredDocuments.item: Final application: indication of support (up to five, e.g. letters of support)
requiredDocuments.quote: Indication of support (up to five; may include letters of support from partners, community members, volunteers; a summary of media articles, broadcasts, testimonials, etc.)
